description: Pinned official documentation sources for Lane B (Python basics, NumPy, and pandas). All sources carry permissive licenses and were verified live with HTTP 200.
isolation_policy: Lane B sources are indexed into a separate collection and must never alter Lane A numbers, existing corpus chunks, or CI gates.

sources.title: The Python Tutorial
coverage: An Informal Introduction to Python (Numbers, Strings, Lists)
More Control Flow Tools (if, for, range, break, continue, functions, lambdas)
Data Structures (list methods, deque, list comprehensions, tuples, sets, dictionaries)
Brief Tour of the Standard Library

sources.title: NumPy: the absolute basics for beginners
coverage: What is the difference between a Python list and a NumPy array?
How to create a basic array (np.array, np.zeros, np.ones, np.arange, np.linspace)
Array shape and size (ndarray.ndim, ndarray.size, ndarray.shape)
Can you reshape an array? (reshape, ravel, flatten)
How to convert a 1D array into a 2D array (newaxis, expand_dims)
How to create an array from existing data (slicing, vstack, hstack)
Basic array operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, dot product, sum, min, max)
Creating matrices and generating random numbers

sources.title: 10 minutes to pandas
coverage: Viewing data (head, tail, index, columns, describe)
Selection (get item, selection by label, selection by position, boolean indexing)
Plotting and getting data in/out (CSV, Parquet, Excel)

sources.title: Intro to data structures
coverage: Vectorized operations and label alignment with Series
DataFrame basics (from dict of Series/dicts, from ndarrays, from list of dicts)
Column selection, addition, and deletion in DataFrame
Assigning new columns in method chains
Transposing and DataFrame interoperability with NumPy

sources.title: Indexing and selecting data
coverage: Fast scalar value getting and setting (.at, .iat)
Duplicate data and dictionary-like get() method
The SettingWithCopyWarning and how to resolve it

sources.title: Working with missing data
coverage: Calculations with missing data (sum skips NA by default)
Cleaning / filling missing data: fillna() with scalar, dict, or forward/backward fill
Dropping axis labels with missing data: dropna()
Missing data in Categorical and nullable types

sources.title: Group by: split-apply-combine
coverage: Splitting an object into groups (grouping keys, grouping by multiple columns)
Aggregation functions (mean, sum, size, count, std, var, sem, min, max)
Applying multiple functions at once (agg, aggregate)
Applying different functions to DataFrame columns
Transformation with transform() and standardizing data
Flexible apply() and handling group keys

sources.title: Merge, join, concatenate and compare
coverage: Concatenating objects with concat() along rows and columns
Handling joins on other axes (inner vs outer)
Merge types: inner, left, right, outer, cross
Merging on column names vs Index (.join())
Merging ordered data: merge_ordered() and merge_asof()
